title: Korean Galbi-Style Apple Glaze
description: Cooked apple gives short-rib-style glaze its body and a mellow sweetness.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm {oil} in the 10-inch HexClad skillet over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Build the flavor
steps.text: Finely dice any whole produce. Cook {apple}, {garlic}, {ginger} for 5–7 minutes, stirring until soft; add a spoonful of water if the pan catches.

steps.title: Simmer the base
steps.text: Whisk in {broth}, {amino}, {molasses}, {ricevin} gradually. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes until the flavors come together.

steps.title: Smooth the base
steps.text: Cool just off the boil. Tilt the pan and blend with a submerged immersion blender until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Pour the slurry into the simmering sauce while whisking. Bubble gently for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.text: Fold in {sesame} off heat. Measure into a heatproof jug; add hot water to reach 1 cup, or simmer excess away before serving.

notes: Yield: 1 cup. Low-sodium option for the full batch: reduce coconut aminos to 4.5 g and keep the same final yield. Use unsalted broth throughout. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For a gentler Option B, omit citrus or vinegar and replace its weight with water. Make ahead: chill in small jars for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in quarter-cup portions up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: whisk over low heat to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat as above. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 43 kcal, 0.4 g protein, 6.5 g total carbohydrate, 1.8 g fat, 0.3 g fiber, 87 mg sodium. Low-sodium version per 1/4 cup: 39 kcal, 0.4 g protein, 5.6 g total carbohydrate, 1.8 g fat, 0.3 g fiber, 26 mg sodium.
